WITH latest_telemetry AS (
    SELECT 
        router_id,
        MAX(received_at) AS last_seen_at,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(received_at)))::int / 60 AS minutes_since_last_seen
    FROM mikrotik_wan_readings
    GROUP BY router_id
),
evaluated AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.router_id,
        lt.last_seen_at,
        lt.minutes_since_last_seen,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.minutes_since_last_seen >= 15 THEN TRUE 
            ELSE FALSE 
        END AS is_currently_offline,
        COALESCE(hs.is_offline, FALSE) AS was_offline
    FROM latest_telemetry lt
    LEFT JOIN router_heartbeat_state hs ON lt.router_id = hs.router_id
)
SELECT 
    router_id,
    last_seen_at,
    minutes_since_last_seen,
    is_currently_offline,
    was_offline,
    CASE 
        WHEN is_currently_offline = TRUE AND was_offline = FALSE THEN 'OFFLINE'
        WHEN is_currently_offline = FALSE AND was_offline = TRUE THEN 'ONLINE'
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS alert_event
FROM evaluated
WHERE 
    (is_currently_offline = TRUE AND was_offline = FALSE)
    OR
    (is_currently_offline = FALSE AND was_offline = TRUE);

INSERT INTO router_heartbeat_state (
    router_id, 
    is_offline, 
    last_seen_at, 
    last_alert_at, 
    updated_at
)
VALUES (
    $1, 
    $2, 
    $3, 
    NOW(), 
    NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (router_id) 
DO UPDATE SET 
    is_offline = EXCLUDED.is_offline,
    last_seen_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_seen_at, router_heartbeat_state.last_seen_at),
    last_alert_at = NOW(),
    updated_at = NOW();
